summary: Comprehensive e2e testing of Crosspost publishing platform. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass (auth, connections, media upload+ffprobe+thumbnail, media validate, publish now, real ffmpeg video transcode, disconnected-platform failure, retry, draft->publish, scheduled auto-publish + daily recurrence clone, AI generation via emergent LLM, dashboard stats, analytics). Frontend: All key pages load with session cookie (Dashboard, Connections, Composer, History, Calendar, Analytics), platform connect/disconnect works, composer publish-now navigates to History and posts show up, expand-row works, filters work, unauth redirects to /login. No blocking issues found.

issues: Bars render in near-black on dark background, hard to see values (see analytics screenshot). Consider brand-colored bars per platform.
Initial GET /api/auth/me on load logs a 401 in console for unauthed visitors (harmless but noisy). Consider suppressing when no session_token cookie present.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~520 lines; still manageable but approaching the 700-line threshold — consider splitting posts/publishing engine into a module if more features are added.
_publish_post mutates the input dict (post['platform_results']) and re-uses it; safe here because we always re-fetch from DB in endpoints, but worth noting.

retry endpoint calls _publish_post with a shallow dict copy containing only failed platforms — works, but 'attempts' counter is preserved via results.get(platform,{}).get('attempts',0)+1 which is correct.
scheduler check_due_posts runs every 30s and uses ISO string comparison for scheduled_at — works because ISO 8601 sorts lexicographically, but a real datetime field would be cleaner.
AI endpoint has no try/except around chat.send_message; if LLM raises, user sees a 500. Consider wrapping to return a clean 502.
seed_data_creation: Test posts created with TEST_e2e prefix; connections toggled on youtube_shorts, tiktok, pinterest, twitter for user test-user-e2e.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~35s. Scheduler test polls up to 70s for auto-publish; if scheduler is disabled it will fail. Video transcode test depends on ffmpeg on system PATH.
